description.text:
We created the most CONVENIENT, comfortable, and TIME EFFECTIVE way to see everything you want and should see in the City of Angeles. From Iconic landmarks to the most famous sign in the world “ The Hollywood Sign”.
You and your family deserve the best service.
Leave the driving and parking up to the guide so you will have a no hassle day.
Leave all the planning up to the guide.
Bring your camera and start making memories !

itineraryItems.description:
The board walk with the famous Muscle beach, skate park and rollerskaters.
Shop the many vendors or watch the talented artists.
The world famous Pier where many oscar winning movies have filmed with its amusement park and end of route 66
A drive through the streets of Beverly Hills . the beautiful mansions the tree line streets and rodeo drive with the high end shops
Drive through Sunset strip ,the nightclubs the famous Instagram shops on Melrose Avenue and the big billboards.
Eat at the original farmers market since 1934 with many food styles to choose from every cuisine there is
Shop the stores at the grove with top shop , Michael Kors ,Brandy Melville and the biggest Nike store in town+ many more.
Oscar theater on its famous walk of fame with celebrity stars In the ground, Many souvenir shops and artist on the street
The biggest iMac theater in the country where many movies are premiered with over 300 iconic hand and foot prints in front of famous movie stars.
Experience driving through the windy roads of Mulholland Drive with its beautiful mansions and views over the city including the skyscrapers downtown LA!
A secret trail only known by a few locals right underneath the Hollywood sign the most famous landmark of the world!
